name: Bizppurio Messaging
description: Bizppurio SMS/LMS and KakaoTalk alimtalk messaging plugin.

settings.title: Bizppurio Messaging Settings
settings.description: Manage Bizppurio integration credentials and sending options.

info.credentials: Enter the integration credentials (ID, password, API key) used for sending and Kakao management, along with the sender information. Verify every value before turning off test mode and switching to production.
info.report: To automatically receive delivery results (success/failure) and record them in the history, register the report endpoint below with Bizppurio.

test_mode.label: Test Mode
test_mode.hint: In test mode, messages are sent to the Bizppurio inspection (dev) domain. Turn it off to send through the production domain.

settings.live_mode_warning_body: Test mode is off, so real SMS and alimtalk messages are sent to actual customers and sending fees are charged. Keep test mode on while inspecting.

api.title: API Integration
api.description: Credentials shared by the sending system and the Kakao management system.

sending.title: Sending Options
sending.description: Sender information used for SMS and alimtalk delivery.

bizppurio_id.label: Bizppurio ID
bizppurio_id.hint: The Bizppurio account ID used for both sending and Kakao management.

password.label: Password
password.hint: The Bizppurio password used to issue the sending token.

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.hint: The API key is issued after you submit it together with your ID to Bizppurio customer support.

sender_number.label: Sender Number
sender_number.hint: The sender phone number used for SMS and alimtalk delivery.

sender_key.label: Alimtalk Sender Profile Key
sender_key.hint: The 40-character sender profile key used for alimtalk delivery and template lookup.

report.hint: Bizppurio can push each SMS/alimtalk delivery result (success/failure) to this address (URL PUSH). Register it with the Bizppurio business team (or the report settings in the console).
report.note: Once registered, delivery results are recorded in the history so you can verify actual delivery. Before registration only the send request is confirmed; the final result (success/failure) is not updated.

binding.list_guide: Link a KakaoTalk alimtalk template to each notification. Use [Connect] to assign an approved template — the alimtalk message is then sent automatically when that event occurs.
binding.section_hint: Only approved alimtalk templates can be linked. Saving applies to this notification immediately.
binding.no_approved_templates: No approved (sendable) alimtalk templates. Register and inspect a template first.
binding.fallback_sms: Fall back to SMS on failure
binding.fallback_hint: If the alimtalk message fails, this notification's body is sent as an SMS instead.

banner.not_ready: Setup required for delivery is incomplete.
banner.test_mode: Test mode — messages are not actually sent.

templates.title: Alimtalk Templates
templates.description: Register, inspect, and manage KakaoTalk alimtalk templates. Only approved templates can be used for notification bindings.

readiness.title: The following settings are required to use alimtalk templates
readiness.note: Enter the items above on the Settings tab to browse and register templates. Actual delivery requires turning off test mode and using templates approved by Kakao.

list_error.title: Failed to load the template list

list.empty_hint: Register an alimtalk template with the [New Template] button.
list.load_failed: Failed to load templates. Check the sender profile key and API key.

form.code_hint: Letters, digits, underscore(_), hyphen(-), max 30 chars
form.name: Template name
form.name_hint: Management name (not part of content), max 200 chars
form.type_item_list_notice: Advanced templates such as item-list should be registered on the Bizppurio website. Templates registered there are also available for listing and bindings.
form.image_upload_hint: jpg/png / max 500KB / at least 500px wide (2:1 to 3:4 ratio)
form.image_maker_notice: The image maker (auto-generation tool) is provided in the Bizppurio console.
form.title_hint: Only content present in the body, max 23 chars (variables allowed)
form.subtitle_hint: Only content present in the body, max 18 chars (no variables)
form.content_placeholder: Enter the body. Insert variables with #{variable}.
form.variables_help: Insert #{variable} into the body; when you bind this template to a notification, it is replaced with the real value (member name, order number, etc.). Below are example variables per notification — insert the ones matching the notification you will bind.
form.variables_quick: Common variables (click to insert at cursor)
form.optional_toggle: Expand optional fields (extra info, buttons, etc.)
form.optional_help: Check only the items you need to reveal their inputs. Buttons and quick replies assume a single web link (WL).
form.button_hint: A web-link button shown at the bottom of the message.
form.quick_reply_hint: Quick reply (web link) used on consult-talk channels.
form.preview_message_hint: Summary shown in the chat list (max 40 chars).
form.extra_hint: Supplementary text outside the body such as channel-add or ad notices (registers the message type as extra-info type).
form.security_flag_hint: Turn on for secure messages such as OTP. The message text is hidden on devices other than the sending device.
form.preview_empty: Enter the body to see a preview here.
form.save_register_hint: Registers as a draft only. To send, request inspection from the list and get Kakao approval.
form.save_and_request_hint: Registers and requests Kakao inspection at once. You cannot edit after requesting.

confirm.request: Request inspection? You cannot edit after requesting.
confirm.stop: Stop this template? It cannot be used for delivery once stopped.
confirm.cancel_approval: Cancel the approval? Re-inspection will be required.

toast.created: The alimtalk template has been registered.
toast.created_requested: The alimtalk template has been registered and inspection requested.
toast.updated: The alimtalk template has been updated.
toast.deleted: The alimtalk template has been deleted.
